title: Apply provider usage to durable budget settlement
description: OBJECTIVE: correlate terminal provider usage truth with the durable reservation so current budget balances and coverage remain conserved after an attempt. HARD DEPENDENCIES: task-e194c5f6ba2c4be3bc83b6a11bfff027 produces the real activated reservation; task-1a7ff170ee544a3a8a10962c25e2ca5b and task-edda1fd35ffc4b6f85789d5f5a80fbfe provide decision-verified ProviderRunTelemetryCommitted readback; task-6b68b07613084de4a079d1c7ddc93bf8 supplies durable settlement transitions. DELIVERABLE: a focused production composition reads the bound provider run, normalizes measurement truth through @moe/scheduler, and commits exact/partial/unknown settlement or reconciliation against the same project/goal/graph/node/attempt/reservation; the ledger current projection becomes the sole balance+coverage source for task-d349d240914b40ada91e9c2b0bc59ae3. NOT IN SCOPE: provider launch, activation reservation, context selection, or treating missing/unknown usage as zero.
definitionOfDone: Production reads the decision-verified provider run for the exact activated attempt/reservation and delegates measurement normalization plus settle/reconcile/conservative transitions to public @moe/scheduler authority.

COMPLETE, PARTIAL and UNKNOWN coverage stay distinct per meter: exact evidence may commit/refund, partial evidence preserves lower bounds/holds, and UNKNOWN quarantines or conservatively holds rather than becoming zero.

Settlement binds project/goal/current graph/node/attempt/provider run/reservation/account/pricebook and observed interval; missing, stale, foreign, ambiguous, corrupt or cross-bound facts refuse with exact source/composition code and layer and no ledger movement.

Replay is idempotent with original bytes and unchanged event/decision counts; conflicting measurement bytes, later reconciliation and concurrent settlement are version-fenced and preserve conservation.

Real SqliteEventStore tests seed telemetry only through its production writer, cover nonempty COMPLETE/PARTIAL/UNKNOWN and later-reconciliation controls plus positive-count hostile/race cases, assert exact code/layer/raw counts, and mutation drills for UNKNOWN-to-zero and cross-binding guards redden named assertions; daemon tests execute nonvacuously.
